Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: complete whole-figure PIXEL ART locomotion sprite sheet for the existing native64 square-grid roguelike. INPUT1 is the EXACT identity, anatomy, view, colors, material coverage and proportion master. INPUT2 is an accepted contact/support timing guide ONLY; never copy its species, face, body bulk, horns, clothes, weapons or palette. Animate only the master.
Layout EXACTLY THREE equal columns by THREE equal rows. First eight complete separate figures in row-major order form one smooth restrained 800ms cycle (400ms per advancement); ninth figure is a real fully grounded resting idle. Same scale, projection, anatomy and framing throughout. Large clean transparent margins within EVERY cell, whole head/claws/wings/feet visible, no overlap or clipping.
Preserve native master silhouette ratio, limb lengths, material patches and attachment points. Head, neck, torso and appendages move coherently as one living figure, with tiny bob. No sliding detached body parts, no independent jittering head, no growing/shrinking limbs, no hopping.
Slightly elevated game view exactly matching INPUT1, parallel axes of square grid; neither profile nor a top-down redraw nor isometric diamond. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean dark contours, muted MATTE original materials; match original shadows/midtones/highlights. No brightened flesh, bleached skin, glossy shine, rim light, glow, blur, noise, painterly rendering or fine speckles. The colored fringe dots on INPUT1 are export errors, not anatomy: outside the real silhouette must be alphaZERO, no colored fringe pixels.
Genuine transparent background and gaps between limbs; no matte, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, text, labels, watermark or border. Preserve exactly the existing appendage count and equipment; do not invent a tail, held object, armor, extra horns or extra hands.
SUBJECT: lean reddish BROWN WING-ARM creature, cream chest/abdomen and pale face/horn ridges, two long pointed ivory head horns, TWO hind walking legs with dark talons and exactly TWO original upper limbs bearing large dark RED-BROWN WING MEMBRANES. The original hands/claws are at raised wing joints. Wings ARE THE ARMS: do NOT add an extra pair of free humanoid arms. Keep the broad low-hanging membrane silhouette spread at the same height and span; wings neither flap, fold fully, lift the creature nor touch the floor. Preserve ivory struts and original membrane area. Native front 78 wide x58 high; rear77x61. Grounded TWO-foot walking, small deliberate alternating steps with low passing feet and visible load on each planted support. Eight phases: 1left contact/right trailing,2weight settles left,3right passes LOW close to left,4right sets slightly ahead,5right support/opposite contact,6settles right,7left passes LOW,8left sets to close cycle. One grounded foot throughout. Short stride and narrow stance; not running, a broad split, a hop, a stomp or a high knee march. Wing joints follow torso with minute restrained movement; no arm swing copied from guide.
VIEW FRONT / DOWN toward viewer. Keep the exact master face, frontal silhouette and ventral material patches.
